outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Mason County precinct results, November 5, 2024 general: 58 precincts; 'Mason County Commissioner District No. 1' and 'No. 2' are on all 56 precincts that the statewide races (Commissioner of Public Lands, Insurance Commissioner) are on, so commissioners are elected county-wide in the general. 'PUBLIC UTILITY DIST 1 Commissioner District 3' is on 7 precincts and 'PUBLIC UTILITY DIST 3 Commissioner District 3' on 55: each PUD's seat is elected PUD-wide, not county-wide.
